newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with last Thursday, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand fair.
Sales confirmed on 3,300 slaughter steers and 3,300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 8,700 head confirmed including 2,200 head of previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaugter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1240 lbs 68.00, pen Select with end Choice 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1130 lbs 68.00; few Select with end Choice 1080-1140 lbs 67.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 66.00.
